FIRST_AND_LARGEST_FINDING.headline: THE BRIEF SAYS SIX WORKSTREAMS WERE PRODUCED. THREE EXIST ON DISK.
FIRST_AND_LARGEST_FINDING.measured: ls audit/element-creation/2026-08-29/implementation/ -> W1-instrument-repair.json, W3-ratchet-breaches.json, W5-contract-truth.json. W2, W4 and W6 are absent — not empty, ABSENT.
FIRST_AND_LARGEST_FINDING.why_it_is_the_largest_finding: W1 + W3 + W5 are, between them, entirely instrument repair, ratchet repair and documentation repair. Not one of the 31 tasks changes what a user of the editor can create, see or export. Every P0 that describes the PRODUCT rather than the MEASURING APPARATUS — F-01 (families dispatchable but invisible), F-04 (read-back proven for 7 verbs of 361), G6 (door binds a store nothing renders) — is unmapped. The plan as delivered can drive the gate suite to green and leave the element-creation pipeline exactly as capable as it is today.
FIRST_AND_LARGEST_FINDING.corroborating_cross_reference: W5-04 twice hands work to 'W2' ('curtainWall.changeLevel is check-command-naming's actual finding, owned by W2'; 'if it dispatches the alias that is a CODE defect for W2'). W5 was written believing W2 exists. It does not — and W3-R4 remedy (A) claims that same file (plugins/curtain-wall/src/handlers/ChangeCurtainWallLevel.ts:79). Two workstreams route one fix to three different owners.

forbidden_fixes.task: NONE — no task in W1, W3 or W5 raises a shrink-only ceiling, extends a named baseline, or adds a gate-debt.json entry to absorb an exit-3.
forbidden_fixes.why: ADJUDICATED CLEAN. Verified by reading every task and by scanning all three files for 'gate-debt', 'raise', 'exempt', 'allowlist': all 13 hits sit in forbidden_fixes or risk framing, never in a change body. Movement is downward everywhere it moves: W1-T1 lowers ARM_B_BASELINE 49 -> 42 on an independently reproduced re-count (OLD 50 / NEW 42 / DROPPED 8 / ADDED 0); W3-R8 shrinks a ledger 4 -> 3 by deleting PAID debt; W3-R6 leaves the graph-coverage LEDGER at 0 and adds four names to a recognition map instead. W1 and W5 each carry an explicit forbidden_fixes list naming the tempting move (ARM_B_BASELINE 49->50; FACTORY_ALLOWLIST; PRYZM_R5_MAX_UNFLOORED — verified env-overridable at check-gate-subject-floors.ts:168; gate-debt for a new gate's first reading) so it cannot be reinvented. On the sharpest test in the set — W1-T4 finds check-tool-activator-coverage RED for a REAL reason (ARM A uncovered 4/0: balcony, bathroom-pod, boundary-line, pool) and explicitly forbids clearing it by adding the four to ACTIVATOR_EXEMPT — the plan chooses to leave a gate red rather than launder a pipeline gap inside an instrument-repair commit. That is the correct call and the hardest one here.

forbidden_fixes.why: NOT A VIOLATION: P4's exit-3 comes from the (window as any) arm at 101/100 (measured this review: RC=3, 'repo-wide scope: 5315 files · 101/100 cast(s)'), and the new arm neither relieves it nor touches its ceiling; the task adds a header clause forbidding exactly that laundering ('a cast rewritten from one spelling into the other is moving debt, and BOTH arms must fall'). BUT NAME THE CONSEQUENCE: the act pins 399 real P4 evasions as tolerable in a gate whose stated exit condition is 'the repo-wide count reaches 0 and the gate leaves gate-debt.json'. Nothing in the plan schedules that 399 to shrink. It also edits tools/ga-gate/gate-debt.json (prose only, not an entry). forbidden_fixes.task: W3-R2-B — NEAR MISS, PERMITTED. ZONE_C_BASELINE pinned as a 2100-path named list.
forbidden_fixes.why: NOT A VIOLATION: Zone C is UNGATED today (it prints and enforces nothing), so any list is stricter than what exists, and the correct artefact is a named shrink-only list rather than a count — the task argues that correctly from C69 §7.c and from Zone B's precedent. C10 §2's clause becomes enforced for NEW files only; the clause as WRITTEN ('every exported function') stays measured for 299 of 2399. The acceptance number (2100/2399) is a truthful printed number that accepts the entire status quo — doctrine working as designed, but a reader who sees P8 exit 0 after this must not conclude P8 holds.

acceptance_theatre.weak_criterion: Acceptance demands the printed line '[cast-tripwire] OK: 0 (ratchet lowered from 3).' — but the change body NEVER SAYS TO LOWER IT and the file that holds it is not in files[]. acceptance_theatre.corrected: Add .ga-gate/baselines/cast-count.json to files[]; state explicitly 'set count 3 -> 0 (a LOWERING, permitted; the gate's auto-writer may do it, but the commit must show the diff)'; require BOTH printed lines verbatim — 'repo-wide scope: <N> files · 96/100 cast(s) (tests excluded)' AND 'OK: 0' — with the baseline diff attached. Separately: the gate exits 3 on the repo-wide arm BEFORE the strict arm prints (verified — the current run never emits a strict line at all), so the two numbers are only observable together, which the task's correction #2 already understood and its acceptance did not encode.

acceptance_theatre.weak_criterion: 'The gate's own RC must be unchanged from its pre-edit reading' — a RELATIVE criterion naming no value, satisfiable by any RC that did not move. The reader cannot tell from the plan whether that RC is 0, 1 or 3. The one place in 31 tasks where D3 is not met.
acceptance_theatre.corrected: Run the gate BEFORE the edit, record the integer, write it: 'RC=<n> before and after, and the printed line MATERIAL_CATALOG rows: 348 (floor 200) is byte-identical across the two runs.' acceptance_theatre.weak_criterion: 'ZONE C (GATED, named baseline): 2100 uninstrumented of 2399 (baseline names 2100)' accepts a state in which not one additional function acquired a span. A printed number, so not a D3 violation — but the criterion most likely to be quoted as 'P8 now passes'.
acceptance_theatre.corrected: Keep 2100/2399 and require a second printed line on every run: 'ZONE C exit condition: 2100 named entries remain; C10 §2's literal clause is measured for 299 of 2399 files.' A ceiling that does not print its own distance from the invariant will be read as the invariant.

acceptance_theatre.weak_criterion: All land EXACTLY at ceiling with zero headroom: sdk-bypass 182/182, Zone B 52/52, window 2/2 and cm.execute 49/49, upward 102/102. W3-R3-C states it outright ('the next plugin that reaches past the SDK fails the gate'). Five arms at exact ceiling after W3 lands.
acceptance_theatre.corrected: Not a defect in any single task — a portfolio defect. Require each to overshoot by at least one: convert a FIFTH plugin bypass, instrument a FIFTEENTH Zone B file, remove one more window read, delete one more upward edge. A merge-blocking suite with five arms at zero headroom re-reds on the next unrelated commit, and the recovery move under time pressure is the forbidden one.

acceptance_theatre.weak_criterion: 'Each must print >= 4, for a total of >= 10 markers' — a THRESHOLD, not the number. 4 and 6 satisfies it; so does 40 and 60. And the task's success depends on those two numbers AGREEING with W5-08's printed marker count, which '>=' cannot enforce.

The task already identifies the failure mode ('if the two numbers disagree with the gate's count, one of the markers is malformed') and then writes a criterion that cannot detect it.

acceptance_theatre.weak_criterion: grep -c 'COMMITTED gate(s) are registered nowhere' returns 0 is a proof of ABSENCE in a log — it also returns 0 if run-all.ts crashed before the pre-flight, or if the message text changed.

still_unproven_after_full_landing: Land all 31 tasks exactly as written and the following is true: the gate suite reads green-er, the contracts stop lying, and a user of the editor can create exactly what they can create today. Nothing else. Not one acceptance criterion in W1, W3 or W5 is a user-facing observation — all 31 are a gate's printed integer, a grep over a document, or a count of markers. That would be defensible if the gates were known to measure the product, but W1 exists precisely because they are not, and W1 only half-closes it: a subject floor proves the walk FOUND FILES, never that the PREDICATE matches its subject. Only two of nine W1 tasks carry an executed control that can be watched failing (T2's empty-root run, T9's planted rival, with T6's STILL-CATCHES-GUILTY-DELEGATED fixture as a third), so after full landing check-runtime-arg-omitted, check-tool-activator-coverage, check-material-maps-tiling and check-render-aggregate-seam are FLOORED BLIND COMPARATORS — able to prove they read a tree, unable to prove they would fire on the thing they exist to catch. That is the M1 defect, a confident number manufactured inside the instrument, relocated one level down rather than removed. Second: five arms end at EXACT ceiling — sdk-bypass 182/182, Zone B 52/52, upward 102/102, window 2/2, cm.execute 49/49 — so 'ga-gate is green' is proven at one SHA on one tree and at no other; the plan watched its own tree move four times during planning (064a838e -> dd2830c6 -> 19b696e1 -> 7fcda39e), and this review measured check-gate-subject-floors already reading 72/1 instead of the 66/7 the plan pins, with W3-R1-A's three spec files already edited by a concurrent lane. Third, and largest: the three P0s that describe the PRODUCT are untouched. 'grid', 'structural' and 'dimension' still dispatch into silence — a successful creation and a silent refusal are still the same number of pixels. Read-back is still proven for 7 verbs of 361 across 3 families of 24 while BOTH mirror gates still exit 0 over that, so the suite will assert coverage it does not have with MORE authority than before, because everything around it got honest. door.create still refuses every well-formed payload and door.batch.create still writes a DTO store nothing renders, persists or exports, under the same key as the authoritative singleton, with a green registration proof asserting the rival object. Fourth: P8 will exit 0 with 2100 of 2399 files named permanently acceptable and P4 will exit 0 with 399 evasion casts named the same way, so both principles read SATISFIED at a state where the invariant AS WRITTEN is measured for 12% and 0% of its subject. Fifth: W3-R4 moves a wire identifier replayed out of project_command_log, and the alias is ASSERTED in every task and EXERCISED by no named test — the failure mode is a load-time 'unknown command type' on other people's data, weeks after merge, which no acceptance command in this plan could detect. Sixth, the smallest and most characteristic: after W5-08 and W5-09 only MARKED counts are gated, so an unmarked count stays invisible by construction — named as a residual and closed by nothing. The honest summary is that this plan proves the MEASURING APPARATUS is no longer lying about itself. It proves nothing whatever about whether an element can be created, seen, saved and exported, which is the question the audit was commissioned to answer.
verdict: REJECT AS A COMPLETE PLAN; ACCEPT W1, W3 AND W5 AS THREE STRONG WORKSTREAMS OUT OF SIX. It fails on COMPLETENESS and on SEQUENCING.
